android.desc:
GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS ARE NOW LIVE!

Dive into Bionic Biome, a fast-paced, retro-pixel roguelite designed for quick, challenging runs. Survive procedurally generated worlds, upgrade your arsenal on the fly, and battle your way to the final boss at Biome 10. It’s easy to pick up, but surviving the Inferno requires serious skill.

⚔️ TACTICAL, FAST-PACED COMBAT

Fluid Dual-Wielding: Swing your sword and fire charged arrows simultaneously using a single, intuitive action button.

Positioning Matters: Watch your back! Enemies deal 50% more damage if they catch you from behind.

Infinite Scaling: The deeper you go, the harder they hit. Enemies and bosses scale infinitely as you progress through your run.

In-Run Progression: Defeat enemies to scavenge upgrades for your max HP, sword damage, and bow strength.

🌍 ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY

10 Unique Biomes: Fight your way from the starting Crystal Caverns to the punishing Inferno. Procedurally generated dungeon layouts mean no two runs are ever the same.

Play Your Way: Choose Casual for boosted drops, Moderate for a balanced challenge, or Impossible for a true test of skill.

Custom Runs: Want total control? Use the Custom menu to tweak enemy counts, difficulty, and drop rates to your exact liking.

📱 BUILT FOR MOBILE

Flawless Touch Controls: Designed entirely for touch screens. Experience zero clunkiness with a custom-built virtual joystick and a UI that perfectly fits any device.

Generative Audio Engine: Every run sounds unique thanks to procedural, dynamically generated music and sound effects that shift based on your current biome.

HOW TO PLAY: Explore the overworld biome to locate the dungeon entrance (moving near it marks it on your minimap). Descend into the dungeon and defeat the boss to advance to the next stage. Need a break? Tap the minimap in the top-right corner at any time to pause your run.

Created by Brant Fuller © 2026. Pollito Productions.

quotes.story_title: I worked for 10 straight weeks on this, it is free, and my first app

quotes.text:
Two months ago, I had zero mobile development or publishing experience. I wanted to see if I could build and ship a complete game using only a browser-based workflow and AI assistance.

The process:

Built entirely in GitHub Codespaces using an AI Copilot.

Wrote the core game for the web, then wrapped it into an Android APK/AAB.

Pushed through 100+ versions to fix edge cases.

Passed Google Play review with no policy violations.

The game is a tough 2D platformer called Bionic Biome. To make the "impossible mode" bearable, I integrated a rewarded AdMob ad as a Continue/Revive mechanic. It’s an opt-in lifeline, not a forced pop-up.

Here is the weird hurdle I’ve hit:
Test ads worked perfectly. But in production, the AdMob dashboard just says "No data" and returns "Ad not ready." My core revive mechanic is effectively disabled because Google's algorithm won't serve real ads until it sees enough "organic" traffic to trust the account.

It's a strange psychological shift. For weeks it was "build, fix, upload." Now, the AI code works, the wrapper works, the integration works, but the core mechanic is held hostage by a silent third-party algorithm waiting for strangers to play it.

Has anyone else here launched a first app and hit this AdMob cold-start wall? How long did it take for your first live ad to actually fill?
